title: Vote report
description: One persona's Round-2 / Stage-3 output: declared votes on findings it did not author, plus derived findings (chorus-review Phase 2; GATE-PRIMITIVE.md Stage 3). In review mode the prose is at most 600 words.

mode.description: review: chorus-review Round 2 (600-word limit). sdlc / challenge: a gate's vote stage.

tool_uses.description: Tool calls made this round; the evidence check runs again on Round-2 output.

own_findings.description: The persona's own finding ids, which it must not vote on (S8).

votes.description: One declared vote per finding the persona has a view on. Abstention is simply no vote.

confidence_on_hand.description: Declared first. low → vote must be NEED_INFO.

vote.description: PRIORITIZE: under-rated, escalate. CONFIRM: correctly rated. OVER-RATE: over-rated, wrong, out of scope or too vague. NEED_INFO: information gap.

reason.description: One-line reason; for OVER-RATE a file:line or one-line reason; for NEED_INFO what is missing.

evidence.description: Citations for project-specific claims ('I read X.py:NN and confirm').

pull_quote.description: Convergence note, marked PULL-QUOTE, relayed verbatim under the entry.

derived.description: Findings derived in the persona's own territory from what other lenses reported. Ids R2-n, graded: false.
